note: DEMO reference prices. Not AI. Every figure below was seen only in web-search summaries on 2026-10-03: the official pages (InfoAserca, SNIIM, Banxico, ICE, AMECAFE) are blocked from the build machine, so no figure was confirmed on an official page. A person must check each value on the source page and set demo=false before real use. These are national/international reference prices, NEVER the farm-gate price in a community: buyers in Chiapas reportedly paid producers about 45-48 MXN/kg in Jan-Apr 2026 (press, product form not stated).
sms_note: Short strings for the PRECIO SMS (card sms_precio): {fuente} = sms_fuente, {fecha} = sms_fecha (the item dates differ: 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-30). Keep sms_fuente short so the SMS stays under 160 characters; it starts with DEMO while demo=true.

items.method: International equivalent, not a market quote: ICE 'C' arabica close 294.85 US cents/lb (2026-09-30) x 2.20462 lb/kg = 6.50 USD/kg green coffee; x 18.0710 MXN/USD (Banxico FIX, published in DOF 2026-09-30) = 117.47 MXN/kg green; x 0.80 kg green per kg parchment (assumed conversion, 57.5 kg pergamino = 46 kg oro) = 93.97 MXN/kg pergamino, rounded to 94. No quality differential, processing, transport or buyer margin is deducted, so farm-gate prices are lower.

inputs.ice_c_seen_at: web-search summary (ICE 'Coffee C' settlement as reported by market news; InfoAserca republishes it at the source_url)
inputs.usd_mxn_fix_seen_at: web-search summary of Banxico FIX in DOF 2026-09-30; official series https://www.banxico.org.mx/SieInternet/consultarDirectorioInternetAction.do?sector=6&accion=consultarCuadro&idCuadro=CF373&locale=es

items.context: ICO composite indicator averaged 287.29 US cents/lb in Aug 2026 (ICO Coffee Market Report, https://www.ico.org/documents/cy2025-26/cmr-0826-e.pdf, search summary). Press: Chiapas producers paid 45-48 MXN/kg (Alerta Chiapas 2026-04-10, https://alertachiapas.com/2026/04/10/el-cafe-chiapaneco-en-crisis/); Veracruz parchment around 4,500 MXN per quintal at the start of the 2025-26 harvest (Quadratin Veracruz, https://veracruz.quadratin.com.mx/cosecha-de-cafe-2025-2026-inicia-con-precios-alentadores/). A December 2025 law creates a committee that will publish official coffee reference prices; use it when it exists.

items.method: Midpoint of the SNIIM wholesale range 8.00-10.00 MXN/kg for white maize (market not identified in the search summary). Wholesale, not farm-gate.
items.context: SADER kept 6,000 MXN/t (6.00 MXN/kg) for white maize sold to tortillerias in the official supply scheme (press, Sept 2026, https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/economia/2026/09/21/maiz-sube-6-pero-gobierno-de-sheinbaum-advierte-no-hay-razon-para-subir-el-precio-de-la-tortilla/).

items.method: SNIIM wholesale modal price for black beans, Estado de Mexico markets, 2026-09-17 (range 17.00-46.47 MXN/kg). Wholesale, not farm-gate. For Chiapas use the SNIIM Chiapas page (edo=5) and keep the same market every week.
